data.one_liner: Build dynamic UIs in Flutter using an expressive, XML based markup language.
data.what_it_does: XWidget enables server-driven UI in Flutter by moving presentation resources into versioned XML bundles. It provides an expression language, controllers in Dart, and cloud bundle delivery while keeping native integrations in compiled code.
use_when: You need to update screens and layout dynamically without shipping a new app build
You want to run A/B tests, staged rollouts, and channel-based UI releases
You prefer an XML markup language mapped to Flutter widgets
avoid_when: You require heavy business logic to reside entirely within markup
You do not want to use code generation for your widget components
strengths: Update UI and copy remotely via XWidget Cloud
Leverage existing Flutter SDK, package, and custom widgets through generated inflaters
Keep behavior in Dart controllers while markup handles presentation
weaknesses: Requires build-time code generation for component registration
Depends on an external cloud platform or custom infrastructure for dynamic bundle hosting
data.setup_notes: Add the xwidget_builder dev dependency, run initialization and generation commands, and register components before calling runApp().
